content.title: Cyber Monday: Consumers search for value in K-shaped economy
content.description:
In spite of growing concerns of an affordability crisis in the US, consumers are spending big at the start of the holiday shopping season. Adobe Analytics expects consumers to spend a record $14.2 billion on Cyber Monday purchases.

Yahoo Finance senior reporter Brooke DiPalma, Winthrop Capital CIO Adam Coons, and HSBC Head of Equity Strategy for the Americas Nicole Inui comment on the state of the US consumer under the pressure of a K-shaped economy.

content.title: Is It Time to Revisit Gap Stock After Strong Three-Year Gain?
content.summary: Thinking about whether Gap is a bargain or a risky bet? You are not alone. With recent shifts in retail, now may be a good time to test the waters. Gap's stock hasn’t exactly been quiet, rising 8.5% over the last week, up 14.3% this month, and sitting on a hefty 105.0% gain over three years. Investors clearly see potential or a changing risk profile. Much of the action comes as the retail sector buzzes with conversations about shifting consumer patterns and Gap’s ongoing turnaround strategy...

content.title: Retailer dependency on value is 'out of control': Fmr. Gap CEO
content.description:
One of the biggest retail holidays of the year — Black Friday — is here, and shoppers are especially hungry for deals this year after tariff-driven inflation has raised concerns about affordability in many industries.

Alex Mill chairman Millard "Mickey" Drexler sits down with Yahoo Finance executive editor Brian Sozzi to comment on the value craze as retailers had to adapt their pricing under this tariff regime.

Drexler also worked as the former CEO of Gap (GAP) and J. Crew and is the founder of Madewell and Old Navy.
